method: Emitted RSC Workspace clientReferenceDeps plus root layout CSS; gzipSync per file; no network/heap/physical-device inference. Static graph excludes dynamic imports unless explicitly marked allHomeClientDynamicClosure. The latter includes all route references and is NOT Home initial transfer.
limitations: Both builds used the same installed node_modules tree; baseline source/lock are exact baseline but dependencies were not freshly restored in an isolated package store.
Current source hashes freeze compared source even if later unrelated commits change HEAD.
File byte counts and graph emission do not prove actual HTTP transfer counts, Brotli negotiation, prefetch behavior or idle heap.
Generated scientific assets present in public/runtime are copied to dist even though unreachable from ordinary Home; total package size differs from initial page load.
